about:
ADCO Plastics Corporation, based in Marietta, Georgia, has been producing custom injection molded assemblies and parts since its founding in 1974. The privately held company operates in the Metro Atlanta area and has grown to become a regional leader in mold building and value-added molding services.

The company runs 22 injection molding machines with clamping forces from 55 to 750 tons, capable of molding parts weighing 2 to 64 ounces. Its process portfolio includes insert molding, sonic welding, heat staking, pad printing, hot stamping, painting, and secondary machining such as cutting, drilling, and CNC milling. ADCO also provides full and sub-assembly, in-house mold building, product design and development, and PPAP documentation, supported by statistical process control and Six Sigma tools.

ADCO serves the medical, commercial, industrial, transportation, and retail markets, working with commodity resins, engineered resins, and thermoplastic rubbers. Customers range from medical device manufacturers to transportation and retail product companies.

The company emphasizes agile customer responsiveness, fast quoting and lead times, and value-added design and manufacturing as its core differentiators. Its quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.
